title: Button
description: Custom button styles for actions in forms, dialogs, and more, with support for multiple sizes and states.

attributes.value: Set the text here — you cannot type it directly into the block.

attributes.label: Button text
attributes.help: Rendered through wp_kses_post(); inline markup is allowed, scripts are not.

attributes.label: Tag name
attributes.help: Only these four tag names are rendered; anything else falls back to a.

attributes.label: Button style
attributes.help: Adds one of Bootstrap's predefined button classes, for example .btn-primary or .btn-outline-primary.

attributes.label: Button size
attributes.help: Adds .btn-lg or .btn-sm for a larger or smaller button.

attributes.label: Text wrapping
attributes.help: Adds .text-nowrap so the button text is kept on one line.

attributes.label: Link URL
attributes.help: Rendered as the href attribute of the button.

attributes.label: Link title
attributes.help: Rendered as the title attribute.

attributes.label: Title attribute
attributes.help: Kept for compatibility. The rendered title attribute comes from the link title above.

attributes.label: Link target
attributes.help: Rendered as the target attribute. New tab writes _blank.

attributes.label: Link relationship
attributes.help: Rendered as the rel attribute, for example nofollow or noopener.

attributes.label: Link opens a modal
attributes.help: Adds Bootstrap's modal data attributes with the link URL as the target. Only rendered when a URL is set and the filter crea_bootstrap_blocks_button_modal returns true.

attributes.label: Show icon
attributes.help: Shows the icon configured below. The icon is only rendered when an icon class and an icon size are set as well.

attributes.label: Icon class
attributes.help: A Bootstrap Icons class such as bi-activity. Bootstrap Icons must be enabled under Appearance, CreaBootstrapBlocks, Assets — or come from the theme.

attributes.label: Icon size
attributes.help: Numeric value without a unit; pixels are added on output.

attributes.label: Icon position
attributes.help: Places the icon before or after the button text.

attributes.label: Show badge
attributes.help: Adds a Bootstrap badge inside the button, after the text and the icon.

attributes.label: Badge content
attributes.help: Content of the badge, usually a number. Rendered through wp_kses_post(); inline markup is allowed, scripts are not.

attributes.label: Badge style
attributes.help: Adds .rounded-pill to give the badge a larger border radius.

attributes.label: Badge background
attributes.help: Adds a Bootstrap background-color utility class to the badge.

attributes.label: Badge text color
attributes.help: Adds a Bootstrap text-color utility class to the badge.

attributes.label: Badge classes
attributes.help: Further classes for the badge, added after the three fields above — for example Bootstrap's position utilities.

attributes.label: Show popover
attributes.help: Wraps the button in a popover container. Bootstrap's JavaScript is required for the popover to open.

attributes.label: Popover title
attributes.help: Heading of the popover, rendered as the title attribute of the popover container.

attributes.label: Popover content
attributes.help: Body text of the popover.

attributes.label: Popover direction
attributes.help: Side of the button on which the popover opens. Directions are mirrored in right-to-left languages.

attributes.label: Popover trigger
attributes.help: Event that opens the popover. Default is a click; the popover opens on focus in either case.

attributes.label: Show tooltip
attributes.help: Adds Bootstrap's tooltip attributes to the button. Bootstrap's JavaScript is required for the tooltip to appear.

attributes.label: Tooltip content
attributes.help: Text shown in the tooltip. It is rendered as the button's title attribute.

attributes.label: Tooltip direction
attributes.help: Side of the button on which the tooltip appears. Directions are mirrored in right-to-left languages.

attributes.label: Show dropdown
attributes.help: Turns the button into a dropdown toggle. The child blocks of this button are only rendered inside the dropdown menu — with the dropdown switched off they do not appear at all.

attributes.label: Dropdown style
attributes.help: Adds .dropdown-menu-dark for a dark dropdown menu.

attributes.label: Dropdown auto close
attributes.help: Controls whether a click inside the menu, outside it, both or neither closes the open dropdown.

attributes.label: Dropdown direction
attributes.help: Direction in which the dropdown menu opens. Directions are mirrored in right-to-left languages.

attributes.label: Dropdown alignment
attributes.help: Adds .dropdown-menu-end to align the menu with the end of the button.

attributes.label: Block ID
attributes.help: Unique identifier of this block. It links the block to its generated inline CSS and must not be changed.
